verdict.rationale: Railway documents deploying from your terminal with its own CLI after developing locally. That implies pushing local project files, but the pack never explicitly says a folder upload works with no Git repo. Nothing shows a deployment can be kept private until published, and the docs say public endpoints are live from the moment you deploy. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of folder or file upload with no Git required, a private-until-publish deployment state, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy a project by uploading a folder of files directly, with no Git repo required and the new deployment kept private until I choose to publish it

citations.quote: Develop locally and deploy from your terminal with the Railway CLI.
